avery.name: Avery
avery.role: Protagonist — young woman with severe PTSD and BPD, placed in Lilyale after killing her father. Burn scars on her arm, scarred back from a bottle attack. Hypervigilant, flinches at touch. Her nervous system has been rewired by chronic trauma.

gray.name: Gray
gray.role: Antagonist/love interest — calculating predator who reads Avery's trauma like a blueprint. Uses intermittent reinforcement: alternates devastating tenderness with violent control. Called 'demon boy'. Possessive, witty, dangerous.

theo.name: Theo
theo.role: Another dangerous inmate who offers Avery a genuine, non-transactional connection. Tattoos over her burn scars as an act of reclaiming her bodily autonomy. Catalyst for the breaking point — his presence fractures Gray's control.

drsmith.name: Dr. Smith
drsmith.role: Avery's assigned psychiatrist. Sterile clinical approach — asks textbook BPD questions, reads off a clipboard. His polite structured method is a language Avery's nervous system does not speak. Contrast to Gray's intuitive predatory reading of her.

sam.name: Sam
sam.role: Hostile inmate at Lilyale. Inherently aggressive. Gray violently defends Avery from him. Theo permanently tattoos a fist onto his face as punishment.

saoon.name: Saoon
saoon.role: Inmate dealing with extreme bipolar swings and the recent suicide of her brother. Part of the hostile environment that pushes Avery toward isolation.

everyman.name: Everyman
everyman.role: Abstract stand-in for the reader/viewer — the one rooting for the villain, the one whose nervous system is being hacked by the narrative.
